exporter.name: lean4export
exporter.role: Comparator's only Lake dependency; both kernels consume its output (docs/paper/independence.md)

platform.landlock: kernel < 6.7: Landlock cannot restrict network (v1 reproduce.md); network blocked by seccomp instead

sandbox.wrapper_command_line: sudo -u checker -H env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$UID_C DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/$UID_C/bus bash -lc "...; systemd-run --property="RestrictAddressFamilies=~AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK AF_PACKET" --user --wait --pipe --collect -E PATH="\$PATH" --working-directory "\$(pwd)" -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=60 $TMO bash -c 'lake env comparator $CFG'"
sandbox.note: $TMO = timeout in seconds (7200 for corpus runs); $CFG = config path; comparator then runs each subprocess under landrun (Main.lean buildLandrunArgs)
